description.zh: 策略ID列表。如存在任意一个策略绑定了未删除的实例组，则整体删除失败。
description.en: A list of policy group IDs. If any specified policy group is associated with an existing instance group, the entire operation fails.

descriptions.zh: 如绑定了未删除的实例组，则不允许删除
descriptions.en: A policy group cannot be deleted if it is associated with an instance group.
